title: Moza AB6 MSFS Setup: North American T-6 Texan FFB tuning & bindings guide
description:
Dial in your Moza AB6 direct drive base for the North American T-6 Texan in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

In the pilot's class, identical airframes make energy preservation and precision line-flying decisive. Under heavy G-loads, radial engine torque and prop slipstream will snap your right wing straight into the deck if you overpull around a pylon. In this walkthrough, we configure full in-game control assignments and calibrate Moza Cockpit force feedback telemetry so your hands feel the angle-of-attack stall buffet and control wash long before the wing drops.

Want to skip manual slider adjustments? Download the ready-to-import profiles on the website:
🔗 Download FFB & Control Profiles: https://highintheflightsimsky.nl
